/kong po rtogs ldan kun dga' rgyal po la gdams pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: /kong po rtogs ldan kun dga' rgyal po la gdams pa bzhugs so//

/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig bu yi dam pa/ slob ma'i yang rab/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug kong yul 'bras mo gshongs 'bras drug smin pa'i sa/ u rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi sbas lung chen po de nyid nas/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pos 'ongs te/ dpal rdo rje gdan gnyis pa/ 'bri gung byang chub gling du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung ste/ nyams rtogs rnams legs par phul ba'i lan du/ cung zad brjod par bya ste/ dang por/ gnas pa skye dka' bar byung na 'ang*/ zhi ma gnas na lhag mi mthong bya bas/ zhi gnas kyi nyams bzang po byung ba de legs 'dug /bla mas gnas pa bshig dgos gsungs snang ba/ gnas pa dang nyams thams cad rang zhi rang dag la 'gro 'jug pa ma gtogs/ gnas pa bshig pa sogs dgos pa min/ rjes su dag nas shor thob byung zer ba shin tu bden/ snang srid gang shar ngo sprad nas the tshom las grol zhing nges shes skyes pa/ sa mtshams de ka yin/ tsā rir bsgoms pas lhongs sogs byung ba gzhung dang mthun te/ ā mo gā pa sha las/ gang tshe dngos grub 'dod pa na/ de tshe las ni ldog par 'gyur// zhes pas so// de nas sprin thag chad pa lta bu'i dge sbyor dran 'dzin la ltos ma dgos shing*/ nyin par gyi dge sbyor mtshan mor 'drongs shing*/ mnyam rjes 'dres la khad pa/ lo 'khor du byung ba shin tu legs 'dug rjes su yi rang*/ sgom med yin bsam pa'i rloms sems/ nyams la zhen pa tsam rang yin/ de nas 'khrul snang dang*/ bla ma keng rus su mthong ba sogs/ rtsa rlung gi byed las nyams yin pas skyon dang yon tan gang du'ang ma bltas pas chog pa de yin/ 'khrul par shes kyang lam du 'khyer ba dka' bar byung zer ba shin tu bden/ 'dir sleb nas/ rdo rje 'chang du mthong ba'i nges shes byung ba/ dge sbyor bogs thon pa'i snga ltas yin/ bla ma la chos skur go na rtogs pa mthar thug skye bar bshad/ thag chod nges shes skyes pa de dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzom pa dang khyod rang las 'phro sad pa yin/

bka' brgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa yin/ dga' sdug ma byed ro snyoms sgoms/ da don gyi nyams myong byung tshul rnams/ gsal 'debs dgos par mi gda'/ stong lta had po'i nyams su ma song bar/ da dung dran pa dgos par byung*/ zhes pa shin tu nas yin pas/ lta rgyu med bzhin du ltos/ sgom rgyu med bzhin du bsgom/ spyod rgyu med bzhin du spyod cig mtshan snang la yang 'dun pa dgos 'dug /ces pa shin tu skabs su bab cing*/ sgom la shor gol med par 'byung bar snang ngo*// lam gyi mthar thug tu byas kyang chog pa 'dug go// da ni dge sbyor gyi sa mtshams dang*/ gegs sel/ bogs 'don/ gzhi 'bras sku gsum gyi ngo sprod/ lta sgom gnad 'gag rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa sogs dang*/ nged kyis myong ba'i mthar thug gi skyel mtshams dgos zhes pa la/ dge sbyor gyi sa mtshams/ ro gcig tu 'dug du ma ro gcig par go ba'i thag chod red/ gegs sel ni/ ro gcig rgya mtsho'i rba la g.yengs bya ba/ sgom med du 'char ma thub pa'i 'phrang sel dgos te/ da dung brtson 'grus kyis mnyam gzhag dang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi tshogs gsog spel sbyang bya ste/ rgyu 'bras mngon sum du mthong ba'i ye shes ma shar bar du sgrub dgos te/ nyams len la mtha' med pa dgos pa'o// bogs 'don kyang 'di'i nang du tshang bar yod/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po 'khor 'das dbyer med/ lam phyag rgya chen po snang stong dbyer med/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ye shes gnyis med do// sku gsum gyi ngo sprod/ sems nyid ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku// gsal la ma 'gag pa de longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs rtog med shar ba sprul pa'i sku// de phyir chos rnams med ces nam mkha' 'dra// zhes so// lta sgom gnad 'gag lta ba khas len dang bral ba/ sgom pa yid byed dang bral ba/ spyod pa blang dor dang bral ba tshul khrims rin po che/

rnal 'byor bzhi la rtse gcig dge sbyor gyi ngo bo phar ma shor/ rtogs pa'i ngo bo tshur ma lus pa shor thob dang bral ba'o// spros bral de nyams dang myong ba thams cad dag pa'i shes pa rjen lhang nge ba sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' lta bu'o// ro gcig de da lta sa mtshams 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems las gzhan du skad cig kyang mi 'dug par snying nas go ba'o// nged kyi myong ba'i skyel mtshams/ sgom med rgyud la skyes pa ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mngon du gyur/ 'khor 'das thams cad sha mong gi sul bzhin du phyed/ chos thams cad la chags thogs med pa'i shes rab skyes/ 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid la dbang bsgyur ba'i rdo rje 'chang thob pa de la nged kyi skyel mtshams su byed do// oṃsupratiṣṭhabadzrayeswāhā// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
